title: listOpenLoops
responsibility: Reads loop states, returns open loops filtered by idle age, retains unreadable-loop diagnostics, and orders results by oldest activity.

inputs.name: listOpenLoops.input
inputs.description: Optional loop root, current-time provider, and idle-day threshold; defaults to process.cwd(), current time, and zero stale days.

inputs.name: renderOpenLoops.staleDays
inputs.description: Idle-day threshold used for the text heading; defaults to zero (all open loops).

outputs.name: listOpenLoops
outputs.description: Open loops in oldest-activity order plus unreadable loop directories and their error messages.

outputs.name: renderOpenLoops
outputs.description: Human-readable list of open loops and unreadable entries.
